content_of_post_to_comment:
i have been trying for months to get off of social media because i want to start getting my life together and i want to start LIVING and being creative again. but it seems like every time i delete it i crave it so badly and its not like there are that many things i need on social media other than being updated on the fandoms im in, so i was confused as to why i was so crazy about social media

and then i realized that its bc i associate social media with community and socialization even if i dont even have mutuals or people to talk to, just seeing other people talk about the same thing and comment on eachothers posts and just being in internet communities makes me feel like im apart of a group and it fulfills something in me.

so i will take this as my sign to go out more and maybe instead of being on the sidelines i can like make my own reviews and stuff instead of relying on other people’s opinions
comment: I think a lot of people underestimate how much social media is filling the "being around people" feeling, even when there's no real interaction happening. Making your own reviews or posts could be a good middle ground too — not replacing community, but becoming a participant instead of just a spectator. It might make the fandom feel more personal.
